repository_dependencies.disposition: retain qualified pin; inspect upstream changes before any re-pin and do not treat live main as an approved packet

decision.recommendation: Retain the qualified Voiage and Reimbursement Atlas pins, do not publish or promote the Hub seed dataset as TA1121 evidence, and treat the successful current-head Atlas validation as a candidate-only qualification receipt.
decision.rationale: Voiage live main passed a bounded compatibility test but is unreleased. Atlas live main contains useful terminology and public Australian schedule context, yet no TA1121-specific approved packet or NHS displacement evidence; source-bundle payloads are not part of the Hub upload workflow and source-specific rights remain controlling.
next_autonomous_actions: Keep the qualified pins unchanged until a released Voiage revision or deliberately selected Atlas revision is proposed.
If a new Hub publication is authorized, bind it to Atlas commit 2183c25ee2bf940a1c8879cfef521474b1fc0dce and the regenerated candidate manifest, then verify remote byte parity.
Re-run compatibility, rights, packet, panel, and exact-commit qualification before changing any lock revision or consuming any newly published bytes.
Continue enforcing research-only outputs and disabled empirical, payer, HTA, policy, regulatory, calibrated, raw-data, and confidential-data claims.
stop_conditions: A proposed re-pin changes an approved packet, transformation, source term, destination, or target commit.
The selected Atlas publication manifest has not been regenerated and reviewed at the exact publication commit.
A source has conflicting, incomplete, inaccessible, or restricted terms.
Promotion would require a TA1121 packet or accountable approval that is not present at an immutable revision.
